Subject: Production latency spike impacting checkout (Velox)

Hi Olga,

We saw a multi-region latency spike this morning starting ~08:40 PDT affecting tokenization and checkout flows for a subset of our EU users. Our telemetry shows round-trip times spiking from ~60ms to ~1.2s and ~15% of requests returning 5xx from your endpoint. This has impacted live A/B experiments and a handful of revenue transactions.

Can you confirm scope and an ETA for remediation? We'd like to understand if this will be considered an SLA breach and whether any goodwill remediation (credits / trial extension) will be available while we evaluate whether to keep the workload on Redwood.

I've attached our local trace slices and a short incident summary.

Best,
Nina Patel
Customer Success Manager
Velox Systems

Thanks Olga — summary for the thread and proposed next steps below.

Summary:
- Scope: intermittent high p99 latency and transient 5xx between 08:35–09:05 PDT impacting ~4% of Velox production traffic routed via EU-A and US-W.
- Root cause (prelim): scheduling inefficiency on a small subset of workers; mitigated with a hotfix at 09:20 PDT.

Proposed goodwill offer (we can finalize after Rev Ops approval):
- $12,000 account credit applied to the next billing cycle (covers estimated excess costs + goodwill),
- 30-day trial extension for their staging/production environments (to make up for disruption during evaluation),
- A 2-week accelerated support engagement (weekly sync with Solutions Eng).

Nina — can you confirm internal expectations on timing and whether a DocuSign credit addendum is required?

Olga / Aditya / Hannah — please advise if the credit amount/terms look OK.
